data.name: Avemary Rocket -Captain Patchwork-
data.detailed_description:
Avemary Rocket is an adventure game where your mission is to explore your spaceship while also trying to keep it running.

This spaceship, The Patchwork, has a secret. But more importantly, it has problems. Boy, does it have problems. Get those fire extinguishers, soldering kits, and vacuum cleaners ready, because even in zero gravity, keeping this old thing afloat won't be easy. And sure, if you have some time left after dealing with all of it, maybe you can explore the place and try to find out what that secret is all about.

The Game

- An intuitive side-scrolling adventure

- Beautiful 2D pixel art

- A journey to Earth interspersed with maintenance work

- Real-time gameplay with time limits for your tasks

- Multiple endings: will the Captain get to Earth safely, or...?

A Day on The Patchwork

- Get up and receive today's list of issues

- Check the map and reach the problematic areas

- Clean, fix, extinguish, exterminate... Just fix the issue

- Spend any time you have left over exploring the spaceship

- Get back to your room before the time is over for the day

The Staff

- Development: Shuhei Miyazawa (past works: Raindrop Sprinters)

- Art: Pixel (past works: Cave Story)

- Planning and production: Masashi Kimura (from room6)

data.short_description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
